a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 cells almost certainly fails. That plan needs at least two rounds of joint operating, so the chance of finishing it is about 4%. I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'd rather tell you now than surprise you. If no storm comes, I'll keep operating with you every round after that so you can reach your 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced, so I've broken our agreement and I'm sorry. If no storm hits, I'll operate every remaining round to rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
